Name: Ochre_T1
EffectText: Ochre can be placed in a palette well. Unlocks the Glaze stroke. Maximum Glim +20.

Name: Ochre_T2
EffectText: A perfect dodge restores 10 Glim instead of 5. Glazed enemies raise ambient light by 0.5 instead of 0.25.

Name: TerreVerte_T1
EffectText: Terre Verte can be placed in a palette well. Unlocks the Scumble stroke. Stamina regeneration +20%.

Name: TerreVerte_T2
EffectText: Moss Poultices heal 60 HP instead of 40. Scumble refunds 25 Stamina on hit instead of 15.

Name: Sanguine_T1
EffectText: Sanguine can be placed in a palette well. Unlocks the Alla Prima stroke. Each killing blow restores 8 HP.

Name: Sanguine_T2
EffectText: Alla Prima heals 6 HP per hit instead of 4. A kill with Alla Prima refunds its Glim cost.

Name: BoneBlack_T1
EffectText: Bone Black can be placed in a palette well. Unlocks the Impasto stroke. Stagger damage dealt +15%.

Name: BoneBlack_T2
EffectText: The Impasto smear lasts 5 s instead of 3. You cannot be flinched out of an Impasto once its wind-up has begun.

Name: Ceruse_T1
EffectText: Ceruse can be placed in a palette well. Unlocks the Erase stroke. Harmful effects on you last 50% less time. Lead toll: maximum HP -15 while Ceruse is in a well.

Name: Ceruse_T2
EffectText: Cancelling an attack with Erase restores 10 Glim. The lead toll falls from -15 to -10 maximum HP.

Name: SlumberBlue_T1
EffectText: Slumber Blue can be placed in a palette well. Unlocks the Sfumato stroke. Dodge distance +20%.

Name: SlumberBlue_T2
EffectText: Dodge invulnerability lasts 0.36 s instead of 0.30 s. Sfumato leaves targets Loosened for 5 s instead of 3.
